mechanism_narrative: A sustained low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS <= 0.20%) compresses discount rates for equity valuation, generating positive 5-day S&P 500 forward returns as the market prices in continued monetary easing.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 5-day forward returns in low-rate periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate rises above 0.20%, it signals the end of emergency monetary policy and beginning of recovery, producing positive 20-day S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in FEDFUNDS>0.20 periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO < 100) and rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE > 7.5%) indicates deepening economic contraction, leading to negative 20-day S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in INDPRO<100 AND UNRATE>7.5% periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).
